# Unifolio

Unifolio is a free mutual fund portfolio tracker for India. It imports a user's
CAS (Consolidated Account Statement) from CAMS or KFintech and shows holdings,
XIRR, gains, and cost transparency (fees and commissions) in one dashboard —
positioned as a free alternative to Mprofit.

Unifolio is a tracking and analytics product. It is not a conversational AI
assistant or chatbot.

Core pages:
- https://unifolio.in/ — product overview and core pitch
- https://unifolio.in/features — Import, See, Understand, Track
- https://unifolio.in/pricing — free-forever pricing
- https://unifolio.in/about — company background
- https://unifolio.in/get-started — signup / demo funnel
